title: Hs golden conformance fixture set (known-hash, future-proof)
author: Peter Higgins; AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001
purpose: A frozen, deterministic test/proof standard. Any future build re-runs hs_gold_fixtures.py --verify; identical hashes prove identical meaning. Hashes cover platform-STABLE rounded signal + structure/pass flags, never IEEE-floor residuals. Extends HS-EPS-1.

tolerances.pass_flag_residual: < 1e-9 (1e-12 for the D=4 sandwich, 1e-10 for the dual-quaternion round-trip)

fixtures.F1_D4_rung: fixed 4-part composition [0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1]; ILR; Aitchison sandwich == SO(3) rotation
fixtures.F2_SOn_ladder: exact SO(n) generated at n=3,4,8,16; rotation angles recovered from the spectrum
fixtures.F3_dualquat_pose: fixed SE(3) pose encoded as a dual quaternion; translation recovered exactly
fixtures.F4_blindness_faces: n=8 rotation-only vs size-only steps separate exactly (suite calibration)
fixtures.F5_backblaze_anchor: real public fleet telemetry: day0/dayN ILR + the rotation angle between them

reproduced: stable across repeated runs (PCG64 seeds platform-independent; signal rounded above float jitter)
governance: instrument-not-data; public data read never copied; nothing posted; Peter is the sole gate
